results.title: The Hinterlands of Our Memories
results.overview: A road movie traveling from Rio de Janeiro to the "sertão" (backlands) of Bahia. With the help of three survivors, the film revisits a 1971 massacre that took place under the military dictatorship. The attack claimed the lives of Captain Carlos Lamarca—the regime's public enemy number one—and José Campos Barreto ("Zequinha"), a community leader and former organizer of one of the few workers' strikes following the military coup. After years of fear and oblivion, the towns where the tragedy occurred now honor both men.

results.title: O Mother, Where Art Thou?
results.overview: A short comedy about a socially awkward 20-something who attends a speed-dating event to find a 'replacement' mother, only to realise that she might be better off without one

results.title: A Naughty Yet Dreamy Boy
results.overview: The quirky and imaginative Jiujiu possesses extraordinary inventive talent. Yet he is mischievous and often plays pranks on teachers with his friends, putting him at risk of being expelled from school. However, the newly arrived Teacher Qin does not blame him. She saves Jiujiu from expulsion and recommends him for the city robotics competition. Jiujiu lives up to expectations and achieves excellent results.

results.title: The Life We Leave
results.overview: When Washington legalizes human composting, entrepreneur Micah bets everything on a new vision of deathcare. With funeral directors Brie and Katey, he builds the first large-scale terramation facility, reshaping how we grieve and return to the Earth.

results.title: The Boots on the Western Front
results.original_title: The Boots on the Western Front
results.overview: An anti-war short film that showcases the horror of modern warfare and its toll on the human psyche as seen in the 1930 Best Picture winner at the 3rd annual Academy Awards All Quiet on the Western Front. The film is paired with a reading of Rudyard Kipling's 1903 Anti-War poem Boots.

results.title: Billy Gauthier: Carving the Future
results.overview: With each stroke of his blade, acclaimed Inuk carver Billy Gauthier instills his art with his passion for his home, Labrador. His carvings are sought after across the globe for their flowing intricate details and profound messages rooted in Inuit culture and connections to the natural world. Billy Gauthier: Carving the Future is an intimate look at the master sculptor’s meticulous process and the inspiration behind one of the most ambitious creations of his career: the carving of a monumental whale skull.

results.title: Wakey Wakey
results.overview: Zombaby puts the fun in funeral in the gory sequel to the award-winning 'Teething Problems'.

results.title: The Youngins
results.overview: He is from Torre del Bierzo, an industrial mining town, where the name El Chispas inherits from, working in the family workshop.  She is a city girl who avoids the summers in his village, Sueros de Cepeda. Floating on his skates.  In a hot summer of the 90s they bathe together in the Villameca swamp. Everything changes when they discover the open secret under its waters.

results.title: Catorce Bajo Derecha
results.overview: María and Raúl have put their small flat up for rent now that they are going to have a baby, but Samuel, their tenant, has stopped paying rent and is showing clear signs of psychological instability. Based on real events.

results.title: Lone wolf
results.overview: The docudrama Lone Wolf follows the life and combat experiences of RAF fighter pilot Josef František. Director Ondřej Veverka presents the story of a pilot who made his name whilst serving with the RAF’s 303rd Polish Fighter Squadron during the Battle of Britain. The film portrays Josef František not only as a flying ace with eighteen aerial victories during the Battle of Britain, but also as a man plagued by inner doubts yet possessing exceptional courage.

results.title: The Shepherd Code: Lapierre
results.overview: Lewis enlists his top agent, Alex Lapierre - aka "The Shepherd" - for a mission that's as high-stakes as it is dangerous: eliminate a list of targets for Tania Edwards, a powerful and enigmatic woman tangled in a massive scandal. But things quickly take an unexpected turn. A mysterious bounty hunter, known only as "The Ghost," enters the picture with a very different agenda: to take out both Tania and Alex, but on whose behalf? Caught between the conflicting demands of his superiors and his own growing doubts, Alex faces a tough decision: follow orders and remain the loyal soldier he's trained to be, or be swayed by Tania's allure and question everything he believes in.

results.title: Illu
results.overview: A writer is on the lookout for new a rental house after the owners of his current home ask him to vacate the place.

results.title: The Long Haul
results.overview: Long-haul trucking has been CJ's entire life. When she receives a letter from the parole board, everything she has been running from finally catches up to her; forcing her to deal with her past, present, and future all at once.

results.title: It's All Fine
results.overview: A dad’s inner existential spiral detonates mid–preschool parent teacher conference.

results.title: Only the Dead Know Brooklyn
results.overview: An adaptation of Thomas Wolfe's timeless 1935 short story where a man tries to direct a drunk to his train

results.title: A Sense of Dread
results.overview: At a remote scientific outpost, four men uncover dark secrets about its past as a mysterious threat emerges, endangering them and possibly the world.

results.title: In the Teeth of Time
results.overview: During a stormy night, our known reality becomes entangled with another dimension. Two different timelines collide and create a fatal ending…
